cites.quote: The read-only summary must be ignored in a `PATCH` body, as HMS-7 did for its count.
The doctor update route `PATCH` /api/doctors/:id is declared in api/src/routes/doctors.ts, and DoctorFormPage saves edits through it.
HMS-7 set the precedent that `the read-only count in a PATCH body is ignored`

findings.text: C15 (PATCH ignores the read-only summary as HMS-7 did) cites impact C14, which only says where the PATCH route is declared. The ignore precedent is impact C15.

cites.quote: EP-3, PATCH /api/doctors/:id, **existing**. `nextSevenDays` in the body is ignored.

findings.text: update(), create() and replaceAvailability() all return this.get(id), so the PATCH and other write responses will also carry nextSevenDays. EP-3 is marked existing with no field changes and does not say this.
